guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve fail-closed behavior; do not solve evidence failures by weakening validation.

guidelinesCompliance.evidence: No release metadata, tag, provider asset, or public release was changed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Add regression coverage before changing each process boundary.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Focused regression tests cover Summary, traceability, archive digest, release intent, and CI evidence boundaries.

risk.detail: Hosted before/after performance measurements and the WI-10 installation-document correction remain later Work Items; this corrective Work Item only hardens process evidence boundaries.

observedIssues.fact: The prior WI-21 Summary had no registered structured hosted evidence field.
observedIssues.decision: Register and validate the field before resuming WI-21.
observedIssues.followUp: Require the field whenever the Contract declares hosted performance evidence.

observedIssues.fact: Archived Work Item paths can remain active references in traceability manifests.
observedIssues.decision: Resolve active references against a unique archive fallback and fail on ambiguity.
observedIssues.resolution: Implemented deterministic archive fallback and tests.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep archive index and manifest digest audit in the traceability gate.

observedIssues.fact: Manual post-finish Summary edits can leave index and Manifest digests stale.
observedIssues.followUp: Use the archive command as the only supported mutation path.

observedIssues.fact: PR #408 entered release-preparation mode from source-bound evidence changes without explicit release intent.
observedIssues.followUp: Release PRs must carry the release-preparation intent label.

observedIssues.fact: Failed template-smoke evidence omitted dependent skipped jobs and produced a misleading binding error.
observedIssues.decision: Keep required-job validation strict and improve the missing-job diagnostic.
observedIssues.resolution: Implemented precise validator diagnostic and regression coverage.
observedIssues.followUp: Each CI job family must publish evidence with a complete job set before verification/publish states.

observedIssues.fact: The release-intent workflow hardening initially removed legacy event-boundary comments required by the existing workflow regression test.
observedIssues.decision: Restore the compatibility comments without weakening explicit release intent.
observedIssues.resolution: Restored the comments and added regression coverage for the new intent marker.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep workflow semantics and review-facing event documentation covered together.

observedIssues.fact: The first final quality run correctly stopped because the Summary retained a stale before_edit Contract hash after the Contract had changed.
observedIssues.decision: Refresh both required checkpoint stages from the current Contract before rerunning finalization.
observedIssues.resolution: Re-recorded before_edit and before_finish hashes; aiAgentRisk passed.
observedIssues.followUp: Checkpoint refresh must be part of the normal finalization recovery procedure; stale hashes remain fail-closed.

residualRisks.detail: The next WI-21 PR run must verify the release-intent label behavior on GitHub; local workflow text tests cannot prove hosted expression evaluation.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
